newsitem.title: USA: Procept in pact to study anti-HIV gel.
newsitem.headline: Procept in pact to study anti-HIV gel.

text.p: Procept Inc said on Wednesday that it has signed a collaboration agreement with the British Medical Research Council to develop PRO 2000, a topical gel to prevent HIV infection.
The Medical Council will evaluate PRO 2000 in Phase I safety study at St. Marys Hospital in London, followed by a Phase II study.
Procept has said the gel is active against sexually transmitted diseases such as herpes and that laboratory studies show it to be active against a range of HIV strains.

Procept, founded in 1985, researches and develops small molecule therapeutics to prevent and treat immune system disorders. It is developing treatments for organ transplant rejection and infectious diseases such as AIDS and tuberculosis.
